secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase project anon/public key (Settings > API). App falls back to a local catalog without it, but live DB reads need the real key.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key (server-side only, Settings > API). Needed for admin writes and Storage sync.

secrets.name: DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: PostgreSQL connection string (Supabase pooler, pgbouncer). Needed for Prisma queries; app falls back to local catalog if unreachable.

secrets.name: DIRECT_URL
secrets.description: PostgreSQL direct connection string (Supabase session pooler) used for Prisma migrations.
